implementation_strategy: Execute a hosted-API pilot using gpt-5-mini (openai_responses). For each of 50 preregistered tasks (public CNSM-rollback-bench-v1 artifact subset) perform paired within-task runs: one baseline call (direct single-shot configuration generation) and one guarded call (single-shot generate→provide up-to-3-candidates→local deterministic verifier selection/repair without extra LLM calls). Verifier and sandbox emulator are deterministic CPU-executable Docker images run locally; all parsing, normalization, equivalence checks, rollback-emulation and scoring are deterministic scripts. No human annotation or adjudication. All seeds, prompts, raw outputs, traces, and SHA256 hashes are recorded and published.
task_manifest_strategy: Use the public CNSM-rollback-bench-v1 intent corpus; select the first 50 confirmatory-intent IDs as the pilot subset. Publish SHA256 hashes of the exact subset and selection script. Each task record includes topology id, intent text, and fixed seed.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic prompt templates for baseline and guarded transformations; parser/AST normalizer, canonicalizer, and sandbox-emulator Docker image versions pinned and hashed. Guarded pipeline prompt requests up to 3 candidate command sequences in a single response; post-processing selects/verifies candidates without extra LLM calls.
execution_batches: batch-1: paired execution for tasks 1-50. For each task: run baseline (one model call) then guarded (one model call); run local verifier/emulator on each candidate. All outputs, timestamps, seeds, and hashes saved.
randomisation_plan: Paired within-task design. Each task uses a fixed preregistered seed equal to task index. No between-task randomization. Seeds and selection procedure published (seed = task_index).
caching_plan: Cache and publish all model responses and verifier outputs; do not re-call model for cached (task,condition,seed) tuples. Cached artifacts accompanied by SHA256 hashes to guarantee reproducibility.
failure_recovery_plan: Hard execution rule per adapter: one allowed model call per pipeline per task. If a hosted-model API call fails or returns non-parsable output, mark task as technical exclusion for that pipeline and record cause, timestamps, and hashes. No additional LLM retries are performed (to respect estimated_model_calls and adapter limits). Local verifier/emulator crashes will trigger up to one automated process restart; if still failing, task is excluded and logged.
result_schema: Per-episode JSON record with fields: task_id, topology_id, seed, condition (baseline|guarded), model_prompt, model_response_raw, parsed_commands_CLI_AST, normalization_status (ok|parse_fail|forbidden_op), verifier_pass (boolean), rollback_required (boolean), action_impact_score (float), timestamp_utc, docker_verifier_version, sandbox_emulator_version, sha256_hash_of_record.
estimated_compute_notes: Hosted-model calls: 100 total single-shot calls to gpt-5-mini (100 ≤ manifest limit 10000). Local verifier/emulator run in Docker on CPU; expected CPU time ≈ 10-30s per task per pipeline (estimate 50–100 CPU-minutes total). Wall-clock completion estimated within 1 day including local verification and artifact archival (within manifest limit of 7 days). All Docker images and invocation scripts are pinned and their SHA256s published.
